correctness.rationale: The tetrahedral zonotope representation gives four generators satisfying a tight-frame identity. Monotonicity of planar perimeter under section-to-projection inclusion and Cauchy--Schwarz prove the global sharp bound; equality forces signed coordinate axes. In a sufficiently small axial chart, the exact clipping endpoints of all four reference-diamond vertices yield an analytic section-perimeter formula and the uniform first-order cusp. Spherical local charts at exactly six maximizers give the stated quadratic tail, independent of finite experiments. The included script crosschecks a separate 24-edge intersection calculation and the local analytic expression.

value.rationale: This gives a sharp extremal intrinsic section-perimeter invariant for the canonical face-centered-cubic Voronoi cell and, crucially, the exact Haar rarity law for almost-maximizing sections. The anisotropic linear cusp and explicit probability constant are geometrically informative beyond a routine isolated maximum or known zonotope representation.
